intro: Walking home you encounter a strange storm. Intense lightning makes you
seek cover. Up ahead you see an old library. It doesn't look open but you
might be able to take cover on the porch. You try the door and are
surprised to find it unlocked. You open the door and slip inside.

stage1_vestibule: You hear the door slam shut behind you and the lock slide into place.
You try the handle but the door is locked. You find yourself in a
large entryway. The library is strangely deserted but there are books
and papers strewn about. You have a bad feeling about this...
stage1_vestibule_respawn: Oh no! Died so soon? Where is the fun in that. Let's try this again.
Shrieking into the dark didn't work out so well, did it?
You're stuck in the Vestibule. Maybe look around before you get us

You spot a backpack on the floor over by an overturned mop bucket,
the mop lying on the floor next to the puddle of water as though
whoever was using left in a hurry. Maybe you should check that pack

stage1_mop_acquired: You turn back and grab the mop, it's wooden handle feels solid in

mopping, but it's better than nothing.
stage2_foyer: You hop over the turnstiles and find yourself in a large, open foyer
stage2_foyer_searched: The ceiling is high with large stained glass windows, but the shadows on
the papers and books scattered on the floor shroud them in gloom.
In front of you is a large semicurcular circulation desk. Just out of
site appears to be whats left of the librarian, the leg of a woman is
visible to the left of the circulation desk. Beyond the circulation desk is
the periodicals section. There are several rows of chest height shelves
with stands to hold newspapers. The newspapers are scattered all over
floor. Whatever happened here made quite the mess.
stage2_corpse_looted: If the woman was the librarian she might have a key to the front door.
You approach slowly. She's wearing a dress with no pockets, but next to
her arm you see her purse. Inside you find [INVENTORY]. No key, but
this stuff might come in handy.
stage2_desk_looted: The circulation desk is mostly empty, surprising for a library. There's no
computers of any kind. How are they checking out the books? There's almost
nothing on the desk and the drawers are empty. Hanging on a hook is a key
labeled 'stacks'. Not the front door key, but maybe the stacks will lead
stage2_both_looted: There's nothing else here except all these newspapers on the ground. They're
all yellowed with age. You pick one up, 1802. Maybe this was an archive of
some kind. You don't see a way out from here, but maybe there's something on
the other side of the room.
stage2_periodicals_check: You walk into the periodicals section, moving slowly, extremely aware of the
sounds of your footsteps crinkling the newspaper under your feet. You try not
to step on them, but you can't help it. They're all from 1802. What kind of
library is this? You stop because you hear something moving in the rows between
the shelves. You can't see it, You don't know if you want to, but there is
defnitely something big crawling down the next aisle.

stage2_reading_room_locked: You try the handle, careful not to make too much noise. It doesn't move, it must be
stage2_fireplace_revealed: The Reading Room is a dead end, but there has to be another way out. You look ahead
and see an antique fireplace nestled into the wall.
stage2_poker_acquired: In a small black stand next to the hearth, you see a fireplace poker. I looks like
a much more formidable weapon than your mop, so you gently rest the mop against
the bricks and pick up the fireplace poker.
stage2_stacks_door_check: Here the bookshelves are taller. You apprear to be in a reference section of some
king. Heavy multi volume works line the shelves in some places and in other places
are strewn about the floor. You walk slowly, holding the fireplace poker like a
baseball bat. Up ahead you see a red door, as you approach it you see it's marked
stage2_stacks_door_locked_no_key: Optimisic for the first time since you go locked in here, you try the handle
but the door is locked. You don't have a key. Who locks the stacks anyway? What
kind of library is this? You're about to turn around and go back the way you
came when you hear something large come up behind you.
stage2_respawn_no_mop: You wake up back on the wrong side of the turnstiles, bruised and deeply
disappointed in your life choices. Wandering unarmed into a darkened
library was ambitious, but stupid. Grab that wet mop by the bucket
stage2_respawn_no_key: You sit up behind the circulation desk, rubbing the back of your neck.
Throwing yourself against a locked iron door with a creature on your heels
is a great way to end up as dinner. You need that Stacks key.
stage2_reading_room_door_respawn: You peel yourself up off the floor outside the double doors, ears still
ringing. Panicking and violently rattling brass handles in a silent,
monster-infested library is an excellent way to get yourself killed.
Be quiet. Try the lock gently.
stage3_arrival: You step into the stacks. Before you can get your bearings, a
horrendous flying creature shrieks and dives at you out of the
gloom! You swing the fireplace poker with both hands, striking
it with a dull crack and driving it back into the shadows.
stage3_early_death_choice: Your journey ended before you could find your footing in the stacks.
stage3_hub_unexplored: You stand catching your breath in the near-total darkness. There are no
windows in here, and as your eyes slowly adjust to the gloom, you can
barely make out towering bookshelves stretching ahead into the shadows.
stage3_foyer_blocked: You turn back and quietly crack open the red door to look into the foyer.
You catch a glimpse of something massive shifting in the shadows just on
the other side. You ease the door shut before it notices you, trapped in
stage3_hub: As your eyes adjust, you make out five long rows of towering bookshelves
stretching ahead into the gloom. Somewhere deep between the shelves, you
hear the faint scrape of claws on wood and slow, heavy breathing—you are
definitely not alone in here. You'd be a fool to walk down any of these
aisles without looking carefully first to see what's waiting. Something
about the fifth row feels completely wrong, an unnatural blackness hanging
over it that makes your skin crawl.
stage3_death_choice: You have died in the stacks.
stage3_hub__peer_down_row_1: You peer down row 1. At the far end of the aisle, you see a set of heavy
glass double doors with faint, pale light filtering through from a room
beyond. It looks like there are windows in there, which might mean a way
stage3_hub__peer_down_row_2: You look carefully down row 2. The aisle opens into a dim, quiet
corridor with no sign of movement in the shadows. Further down, you can
barely make out a fallen figure lying motionless on the floor.
stage3_hub__peer_down_row_3: You look carefully down row 3. At first glance the aisle looks empty,
with no bodies or supplies in sight, until you notice deep claw gouges
torn into the wooden shelves and dark drag marks leading into the
stage3_hub__peer_down_row_4: You look carefully down row 4. The aisle is narrow and choked with
leaning bookshelves—far too tight for anything large to lurk near the
entrance. Resting against a shelf just a few steps in is a discarded
backpack. Who knows what kind of supplies might be inside.
stage3_row1_encounter: You walk down the first row and reach the heavy glass double doors.
Faint, pale light filters through the frosted glass from a vast room
beyond, where tall arched windows let in the dim glow of the storm
outside. The glass is dusty and smeared—you'd have to press closer to
get a clear look at what's inside.
stage3_row1_looked: You press closer and look through a clear patch in the glass. Beyond
the doors lies a grand, two-story reading room lined with ornate
balconies, dark wood paneling, and long oak tables beneath tall arched
windows. Then your breath catches—sprawled in the shadows between the
tables on the lower floor is an enormous, hulking creature, its massive
silhouette rising and falling with slow, heavy breaths. It hasn't
stage3_row2_encounter: You walk quietly down row 2, the air cool and still between the tall
shelves. Ahead, the motionless figure of a man lies slumped near the
base of a bookcase, a large black umbrella resting on the floor beside
his hand. Just beyond where he lies, the corridor fades into deep shadow.
stage3_row2_looted: You kneel beside the body and check his coat pockets before picking up
the heavy black umbrella lying next to him. Just a few paces further
down the aisle, the dim ambient light cuts off completely, swallowed
by a wall of pitch darkness.
stage3_row2_dark_warning: You stop at the edge of the shadows. Beyond this point, the corridor
is completely pitch-black—you can't see a foot ahead of you, and
there's no telling what might be lurking in the dark. You're too
uneasy to push forward without more light; maybe there's a way to
turn on the lights somewhere back in the stacks.
stage3_row4_encounter: You slip a few steps into row 4, squeezing between the tall, leaning
bookshelves. The narrow gap feels cramped, though the heavy timber
shelves press close enough around you to offer a small pocket of
shelter. The discarded backpack lies right at your feet, its zippers
stage3_row4_looted: You rummage through the pack and pull out a heavy-duty flashlight along
with a few spare supplies. As you straighten up, your eyes catch faint,
familiar scrape marks along the floorboards just beyond the pack,
vanishing further down the narrow aisle.
stage3_row5_warning: You lean toward the entrance of the fifth row and peer into the gloom.
Your hair stands on end. The blackness hanging between these shelves
feels thick and suffocating, swallowing every sound from the rest of
the library. Every instinct screams at you to step back before you look
stage4_entry: You enter the deep stacks maze.
stage4_death_choice: You have died in the deep stacks maze.

stage1_vestibule__try_to_leave: You turn and grab the door handle. You have to get out of here. The door won't budge.
You panic and yell out 'Somebody help me!' You bang loudly on the door hoping to
catch the attention of a passerby. You're so busy banging on the door you don't
notice that the sound has gotten the attention of something lurking in the library.
It jumps on your back and kills you. You die never knowing what it was.
stage2_foyer__go_deeper: You walk into the dimly lit foyer, past the circulation desk towrds
the shelves of books. You're looking at the windows for one that opens
so you don't see the body on the floor. You trip and fall flat on your
face. When you roll to your side to get back up, you see a reptile like
creature low on the ground coming at you with surprising speed. You try
to get up but you aren't fast enough. It pounces on you and you're dead
before you know what hit you.
stage2_reading_room_door__rattle_reading: The door is locked. Frustrated, you grab both handles and pull
hard, shaking the door in its frame. You hear a noise behind you.
The monster you heard earlier is 5 feet away, drawn by the noise,
its approach masked by your panicked rattling of the door. It eats
stage2_stacks_door_locked_no_key__defend: You turn to face the monster but before you can swing your weapon,
it pounces. You're dead, but at least the monster isn't hungry anymore.
stage2_stacks_door_locked_no_key__slowly: You back away slowly. 'Nice hideous monster' you say in a soothing voice.
Nice or not, it's hungry and it eats you. You die.
stage3_arrival__with_mop_check: You step into the stacks. Before you can get your bearings, a horrendous
flying creature shrieks and dives at you out of the gloom! You try to
swing the unwieldy mop, but trip over the handle and die.
stage3_foyer_blocked__go_deeper: Rattled by what's waiting on the other side of the door, you hurry forward
into the dark without looking where you're going. You hear a rustle
in the gloom before heavy claws slam into your chest, knocking the fireplace
poker from your hands. You hit the floor hard, and the shadows close in
stage3_hub_unexplored__go_deeper: Before your eyes can adjust to the dark, you step blindly forward between
the towering shelves. You hear a rustle in the gloom before heavy
claws slam into your chest, knocking the fireplace poker from your hands.
You hit the floor hard, and the shadows close in around you.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_1__else: You stride straight down row 1 toward the faint glow at the far end
without checking the shadows between the shelves. Halfway down the
aisle, something drops from the upper racks right behind you, slamming
you onto the floorboards before you can turn around.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_2__else: You hurry down row 2 without peering into the dim corridor first. In
the gloom, you trip over the slumped body of a man you didn't see
lying near the shelves—crashing flat onto your face just as something
drops from the top of the bookcases and lands heavily on your back.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_3: You slip down row 3 and kneel beside the dark drag marks, setting the
fireplace poker against a shelf so you can examine the gouges in the
wood more closely. A low, wet rasp echoes from the shadows just ahead—
and as you lunge back for the poker, your fingers brush empty air a
split second before the creature pounces.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_4__else: You push straight into row 4 without looking first, squeezing carelessly
between the leaning bookshelves. You catch your foot on a discarded
backpack half-hidden in the gloom, wedging yourself tightly between the
tilted timber racks—completely trapped as jagged jaws snap down from the
stage3_hub__go_down_row_5: Even as something inside you warns you to stay back, the deep shadow
filling the fifth row seems to beckon you closer. Before you realize
what you are doing, you step across the threshold into its reach.
Mesmerized, you let the dark close around you like a warm embrace,
stage3_row1_encounter__enter_the_reading: You ease open the heavy glass doors and slip into the dim light of the
reading room. Ahead, a massive shape begins to rise from between the
oak tables—and keeps rising, towering toward the second-floor balconies.
Before you can even turn back toward the doors, it simply bends down
and swallows you whole right where you stand.
stage3_row2_dark_warning__go_deeper: You push forward into the pitch blackness, running one hand along the
spines of the books to keep your bearings. The faint light behind you
vanishes completely as the darkness swallows you whole—if only you had a
flashlight. Then you hear a low, heavy scraping just ahead in the dark,
and before you can turn back, something massive grabs you with its teeth.
stage3_row4_encounter__go_deeper: You squeeze past the discarded backpack and push deeper into the narrow
gap between the leaning shelves. The cramped aisle grows darker with
every step until you can barely see a foot in front of you—and before
you realize you've reached the end of the row, long, hooked limbs drop
from the top of the bookcase and clamp around your shoulders.
stage3_row4_looted__go_deeper: You click on the flashlight and press deeper between the leaning
bookshelves, sweeping the beam along the floor to follow the scrape
marks. As the aisle narrows to a dead end, the trail abruptly turns
upward—gouging deep furrows straight up the side of the wooden
bookcase just as long, hooked limbs drop down on you from above.
stage3_row5_warning__peer: Ignoring every instinct screaming at you to step back, you lean closer
and squint into the unnatural blackness of the fifth row. The darkness
surges outward across the threshold and swallows you whole before you can
draw a breath. Whatever claims you in that void gives you no time to cry
